narration: A raise arrived, and the finish line walked away by exactly the same logic.
caption: सैलरी बढ़ी, और उसी हिसाब से मंज़िल भी आगे खिसक गई।
image_brief: A finish tape on a running track being carried further down the lane by the wind, empty stadium seats behind it, bright morning light.

narration: Version two. Spending stays at forty thousand, so saving jumps to twenty-five thousand.
caption: दूसरा रास्ता: खर्च 40,000 पर टिका रहता है, बचत 25,000 हो जाती है।
image_brief: The same household shopping basket on the kitchen floor filled only to its usual level, a few unbought packets left on the shelf above, light from a doorway.

narration: That is thirty-eight percent of take-home. The target stays at one crore twenty lakh.
caption: यह कमाई का 38 प्रतिशत है। लक्ष्य 1.2 करोड़ पर ही टिका रहता है।
image_brief: A glass jar on a counter filled well past the tape mark near its middle, the tape itself unmoved, bright noon light.

narration: Twenty-five saved against forty spent is five-eighths of a year, per year worked.
caption: 40,000 खर्च के मुक़ाबले 25,000 बचत, यानी हर साल का पाँच-बटा-आठ साल।
image_brief: A round flatbread on a plate cut into eight wedges with five wedges pushed to one side, kitchen window light.

narration: Seven and a half months bought per year, up from three. Same raise.
caption: अब हर साल साढ़े सात महीने मिलते हैं, तीन के बजाय। वही सैलरी बढ़ोतरी।
image_brief: A row of twelve small glass bottles on a windowsill, seven full of water and the eighth half full, afternoon light behind them.

narration: This arithmetic is deliberately blind to growth. Real pots grow while they sit.
caption: यह गणित जान-बूझकर बढ़त को छोड़ देता है। असली फंड रखे-रखे बढ़ता है।
image_brief: A sapling in a clay pot standing beside a full-grown tree in a courtyard, both rooted in the same soil, soft morning light.

narration: Growth shortens the wait, sometimes sharply. The ratio is the starting point, not the answer.
caption: बढ़त इंतज़ार घटाती है, कभी बहुत। अनुपात शुरुआत है, पूरा जवाब नहीं।
image_brief: A steep hill road with a narrow footpath cutting straight across its bends, dry grass on both sides, early sun.

narration: It also assumes later spending resembles spending now. Often it does not.
caption: यह भी मानता है कि आगे का खर्च आज जैसा रहेगा। अक्सर नहीं रहता।
image_brief: A hospital corridor bench with a folded shawl and a steel water bottle resting on it, cool fluorescent light overhead.

narration: Health costs, family duties, a shifted city: each one moves the target.
caption: इलाज का खर्च, परिवार की ज़िम्मेदारी, शहर बदलना: हर बात लक्ष्य बदल देती है।
image_brief: A packed suitcase and two taped cardboard boxes standing by a flat's open door, an empty name plate on the frame, hallway light.

narration: The multiple itself is a rough illustration. Nobody is owed a fixed withdrawal.
caption: वह गुणक भी बस एक मोटा उदाहरण है। तय निकासी किसी का हक़ नहीं है।
image_brief: A painted measuring stick nailed to the inner wall of a stone well, its lower marks worn away, dim light down the shaft.

narration: Now the harder limit. The fraction means little near the cost of survival.
caption: अब बड़ी सीमा। गुज़ारे की हद के पास यह अनुपात मायने नहीं रखता।
image_brief: A bare kitchen shelf holding one steel tin of flour and a single onion, harsh afternoon light through a small window.

narration: If rent and food take almost everything, the lever is not the rate.
caption: जब किराया और खाना ही सब ले जाएँ, तो बचत दर कोई चाबी नहीं है।
image_brief: A rent receipt and a vegetable bill weighed down by a stone on a doorstep, an open empty wallet beside them, flat daylight.

narration: It is income, or the cost of the basics. Arithmetic cannot conjure a gap.
caption: चाबी है कमाई, या ज़रूरी चीज़ों की क़ीमत। गणित अंतर पैदा नहीं कर सकता।
image_brief: A dry hand pump in a village square with an empty bucket beneath its spout, midday sun directly overhead.

narration: A high savings rate is a privilege before it is a discipline.
caption: ऊँची बचत दर अनुशासन से पहले एक सहूलियत है।
image_brief: Two tenement roofs across a narrow lane, one carrying a full water tank and the other only an empty steel frame, hazy evening light.

narration: The common mistake is a different one, and it catches comfortable earners.
caption: आम ग़लती कुछ और है, और वह अच्छी कमाई वालों को पकड़ती है।
image_brief: A tidy living room with one unopened appliance carton in the corner and a small stack of plain membership cards on the table, lamp light.
